title: Harness Forge
subtitle: Use your Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode plugins and settings in DSH.
intro: Harness Forge found the plugins and settings on this computer. Migrate them to use them here; anything DSH can't run yet is listed under Gaps, where AI can write an adapter for it.
verdictNoneDetail: None of its parts can run in DSH yet.
disabledInNote: Switched off in {harness}: Migrate all leaves it out. Migrating it here turns it on in DSH.
enabledUnknownNote: Whether {harness} runs it can't be told: an entry in its config switches plugins by id, and this plugin's id {why}. Migrate all leaves it out; migrate it on its own if you use it.
pluginIdMissing: is declared by no Plugin.define({ id }) that can be read
pluginIdDynamic: is computed, not a plain string
pluginIdEscape: is written with an escape JavaScript refuses in a module
nothingFound: No {name} plugins or settings were found on this computer.
marketLead: Install Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode plugins straight from the internet; you don't need those harnesses installed. Paste a marketplace or a plugin, or open one of the marketplaces below.
marketPath: owner/repo, git URL, marketplace.json URL, or npm package
marketLocal: On this computer: marketplaces your harnesses added. Their plugins are not migrated with the rest; install the ones you want.
marketNoGit: git is not installed: GitHub sources are downloaded over HTTPS; other git hosts need git.
marketMore: {n} more; narrow the filter to see them.
confirmNoCode: Nothing in this plugin runs code; it adds only text the agent reads.
confirmTrust: Install plugins only from a source you trust.
confirmCodeRuns: These parts run code with your permissions once installed: {names}.
confirmCodeNone: Nothing in this plugin runs code in DSH until you build an adapter for {names}.
confirmCodeNoneNoAdapter: None of the parts that hold code run in DSH: {names}.
confirmCodeAdapter: An adapter you build later runs its own code with your permissions.
codeGapInDsh: a gap, runs nothing in DSH.
confirmReinstall: It is already installed; installing replaces it with this copy.
confirmDependencies: Its npm dependencies ({n} declared) will be installed from {registry} when you confirm.
remoteRemoveHint: Remove a plugin in Migrated; its downloaded files are deleted with it.
manualLead: Point to a plugin folder: one with .claude-plugin/plugin.json, a Codex plugin, or an OpenCode project.
startsHookOne: {owner} SessionStart hook runs only when a new session starts; its other parts already work.
startsHookOneAlone: {owner} SessionStart hook runs only when a new session starts.
startsHookMany: The SessionStart hooks of {names} run only when a new session starts; their other parts already work.
startsHookManyAlone: The SessionStart hooks of {names} run only when a new session starts.
migratedLead: Everything that is active in DSH, plugin by plugin. Switch single parts off, or remove a plugin to undo its migration.
migratedEmpty: Nothing is migrated yet. Start in Discover & migrate.
removeConfirm: Remove {name} from DSH? Its own files stay where they are, and you can migrate it again later.
removeConfirmFetched: Remove {name} from DSH? It was downloaded by Get plugins, so its downloaded files are deleted too; you can install it again later.
detachedUninstalled: No longer installed in {harness}, so nothing of it runs.
detachedSwitchedOff: Switched off in {harness}, so nothing of it runs.
detachedNeverInstalled: Not installed in {harness}: an earlier version of Harness Forge migrated it from {harness}'s folders anyway. Nothing of it runs.
detachedMisread: An earlier version of Harness Forge migrated this {harness} plugin as another harness's. Nothing of it runs; migrate the {harness} plugin again from Discover.
detachedChoose: Keep it as your own copy (it stays where it is and no longer follows {harness}), or remove it.
detachedFolderGone: Its folder is gone too: remove it.
reasonNotFollowed: Not running: {harness} no longer runs this plugin.
partInactiveHint: Turn on “{row}” in Plugin Manager to use it.
signInLead: These MCP servers work after you sign in.
signInOpened: The sign-in page opened in your browser; the server connects when you finish. If it didn't open, visit:
gapsLead: Parts that can't fully run in DSH, and why. Where an adapter could fill the gap, AI can write it for you.
gapsEmpty: No gaps: everything found here works in DSH.
fillPreviewTitle: The task the AI is given
coveredLead: These gaps are already filled by adapters installed in DSH.
reasonEventsNeverRaised: DSH never raises these events, so their hooks don't run:
reasonCannotBlock: DSH reports these events after the fact, so a hook can't stop them:
reasonHandlersInert: DSH doesn't run hook handlers of these types:
reasonOutputStyle: The output style is added to DSH's instructions but can't replace DSH's own coding guidance.
reasonExperimentalRuntime: This code plugin runs through a compatibility layer that offers only part of what it may use.
reasonNoEquivalentUi: DSH has no place to show this; an adapter has to draw it.
reasonNotMapped: DSH has nothing that does this:
reasonHostedConnector: This is an app connector hosted by OpenAI; it only works signed in to ChatGPT or Codex.
reasonUnknownTransport: It isn't clear how to connect to this MCP server.
reasonDisabledInPlugin: The plugin switched this MCP server off, so DSH doesn't start it.
reasonDisabledInConfig: config.toml switched this MCP server off, so DSH doesn't start it.
reasonDisabledInClaudeCode: Claude Code has this project MCP server switched off (disabledMcpjsonServers), so DSH doesn't start it.
reasonNeedsChatgptSignIn: This MCP server needs a ChatGPT sign-in, which DSH can't provide; an adapter can't either.
reasonRunFailed: It failed when it ran in DSH:
reasonUnreadable: Its files can no longer be read (moved or deleted?):
reasonRowOff: The Harness Forge part that runs it is off.
sessionsLead: Bring past Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode conversations into DSH as sessions you can read and continue.
sessionTooLarge: This session is too large to import ({size}; the limit is {limit}).
sessionTooLargeDecoded: This session is too large to import: decompressed, it is over the limit of {limit}.
sessionMaybeImported: An earlier import may already hold this conversation: open that session, or import this one as a new session.
sessionUnarchived: You had archived this session in DSH; it is back in the session list.
sessionStillArchived: You archived this session in DSH and it can't be taken out of the archive from here. Unarchive it under DSH's archived sessions, then open it.
chatImportPitch: For session import, try dsh-chat-import: it brings conversations from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 40+ other agents into DSH as sessions you can continue.
chatImportConfirm: Install dsh-chat-import from npm into this DSH?
chatImportCommand: Install it from DSH's Plugins page, or run: {command}
chatImportRestart: dsh-chat-import is installed; it starts after DSH restarts.
chatImportInstalledLater: dsh-chat-import is installed; reload this page if its Import sessions button does not show yet.
chatImportProvided: Session import is provided by dsh-chat-import — use its Import sessions button in the sidebar.
settingsLead: Where Harness Forge looks for plugins, and what it adds to new sessions.
autoDiscover: Look for plugins when this page opens
contextLead: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md files of the current project are added to new sessions.
contextYielding: {name} handles these files, so Harness Forge leaves them to it.
contextNone: No instruction files were found for the current project.
contextOff: Off: the Harness Forge part that adds them is switched off.
diagnosticsLead: What Harness Forge needs from this computer, and anything that went wrong.
diagRowsOk: Harness Forge itself started normally; the migrated parts below did not.
diagAllOk: Harness Forge and every migrated part started normally.
diagBunMissing: Not found; installed on first use
fillUnavailable: AI can't fill gaps right now:
trustLead: Sessions in {folder} use project hooks, MCP servers or shell commands from the folder's own files. They run code on this computer, so they stay off until you trust the folder. Only trust folders whose contents you know.
trustWaiting: waiting for you to trust this workspace
trustSettingsLead: Folders you trusted here or chose "Not now" for. Revoking trust turns the folder's project hooks, MCP servers and shell commands off again in open sessions; its deny and ask rules always apply.
trustSettingsNone: No folder has a decision yet.
trustStateDismissed: Not now: the banner is hidden
trustStillLive: Some parts could not be switched off and are still running: {list}
workbenchOff: “Harness Forge page” is turned off. Turn it on in Plugins.
